notes.title: Improved Level Design Update
notes.content:
- Improved level design for smoother progression and less collisions and frustration
- Fixed a technical issue related to framerate independence
- Updated to a newer version of nw.js

notes.title: Update Notes for April 22
notes.content:
-the escape key now also works to pause
-on some systems numpad 0 did not work for skipping hurdles in the agility world
-small improvements for the color schemes
-anti-collision updates in the shop have a more noticeable effect
-jump improvements from hats have a more noticeable effect

notes.title: Beautiful World Update
notes.content:
This is a big update that introduces new beautiful color schemes to the first two worlds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40896532/be372732f107e337557fff2b021c660122cace0c.gif[/img]

Furthermore, the difficulty is slightly reduced for a better overall experience:
-Some levels are shorter
-More booster stars when you are in a bad mood for too long
-Collision is disabled on some small or tricky objects

notes.title: Gameplay improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
-General level design improvements to reduce frustrating situations and improve the overall experience

-Slightly increased bounce for low-end hats

-Fixed a bug in World 1 Level 13 where the dog did not jump at the beginning of the level

-Fixed a bug in World 3, possible stuttering of the interface at the end of the level

-Fixed a bug where the mood display was not bright in front of dark surfaces

-Fixed a bug where the dog's facial expressions no longer changed

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
-Some elements are more precisely adapted to the slightly reduced movement speed introduced in the last update

-Fixes some minor issues on ultra-wide 21: 9 monitors

notes.title: First Small Userfeedback Update
notes.content:
-more comfort for the eyes on large screens: slight zoom out, slight reduction in movement speed

-F12 works now for screenshots
